verses.en: But now thus saith the LORD that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.
verses.pt: Porém agora assim diz o SENHOR, o teu Criador, ó Jacó, e o teu Formador, ó Israel: Não temas, porque eu te resgatei; chamei a ti por teu nome; tu és meu.
verses.en_web: But now Yahweh who created you, Jacob, and he who formed you, Israel says: “Don’t be afraid, for I have redeemed you. I have called you by your name. You are mine.
verses.en_bbe: But now, says the Lord your Maker, O Jacob, and your life-giver, O Israel: have no fear, for I have taken up your cause; naming you by your name, I have made you mine.

verses.en: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.
verses.pt: Quando passares pelas águas, estarei contigo; e ao passares pelos rios, eles não te submergirão; quando passares pelo fogo, não te queimarás, nem a chamas arderão em ti.
verses.en_web: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned, and flame will not scorch you.
verses.en_bbe: When you go through the waters, I will be with you; and through the rivers, they will not go over you: when you go through the fire, you will not be burned; and the flame will have no power over you.

verses.en: For I am the LORD thy God, the Holy One of Israel, thy Saviour: I gave Egypt for thy ransom, Ethiopia and Seba for thee.
verses.pt: Porque eu sou o SENHOR teu Deus, o Santo de Israel, teu Salvador; dei ao Egito, a Cuxe, e a Seba como teu resgate, em teu lugar.
verses.en_web: For I am Yahweh your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior. I have given Egypt as your ransom, Ethiopia and Seba in your place.
verses.en_bbe: For I am the Lord your God, the Holy One of Israel, your saviour; I have given Egypt as a price for you, Ethiopia and Seba for you.

verses.en: Since thou wast precious in my sight, thou hast been honourable, and I have loved thee: therefore will I give men for thee, and people for thy life.
verses.pt: Visto que foste precioso em meus olhos, assim foste glorificado, e eu te amei; por isso dei homens em troca de ti, e povos em troca de tua alma.
verses.en_web: Since you have been precious and honored in my sight, and I have loved you; therefore I will give people in your place, and nations instead of your life.
verses.en_bbe: Because of your value in my eyes, you have been honoured, and loved by me; so I will give men for you, and peoples for your life.

verses.en: Fear not: for I am with thee: I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west;
verses.pt: Não temas, pois estou contigo; eu trarei tua semente desde o oriente, e te ajuntarei desde o ocidente.
verses.en_web: Don’t be afraid; for I am with you. I will bring your offspring from the east, and gather you from the west.
verses.en_bbe: Have no fear, for I am with you: I will take your seed from the east, and get you together from the west;

verses.en: I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, Keep not back: bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the ends of the earth;
verses.pt: Direi ao norte: Dá!, E ao sul: Não retenhas! Trazei meus filhos de longe, e minhas filhas desde os confins da terra;
verses.en_web: I will tell the north, ‘Give them up!’ and tell the south, ‘Don’t hold them back! Bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the ends of the earth—
verses.en_bbe: I will say to the north, Give them up; and to the south, Do not keep them back; send back my sons from far, and my daughters from the end of the earth;

verses.en: Even every one that is called by my name: for I have created him for my glory, I have formed him; yea, I have made him.
verses.pt: Todos os chamados do meu nome, e os que criei para minha gloria; eu os formei; sim, eu os fiz.
verses.en_web: everyone who is called by my name, and whom I have created for my glory, whom I have formed, yes, whom I have made.’”
verses.en_bbe: Every one who is named by my name, and whom I have made for my glory, who has been formed and designed by me.

verses.en: Bring forth the blind people that have eyes, and the deaf that have ears.
verses.pt: Trazei ao povo cego, que tem olhos; e aos surdos, que tem ouvidos.
verses.en_web: Bring out the blind people who have eyes, and the deaf who have ears.
verses.en_bbe: Send out the blind people who have eyes, and those who have ears, but they are shut.

verses.en: Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the people be assembled: who among them can declare this, and shew us former things? let them bring forth their witnesses, that they may be justified: or let them hear, and say, It is truth.
verses.pt: Todas as nações se reúnam, e os povos se ajuntem. Quem deles isto isto anuncia, e nos faz ouvir as coisas do passado? Mostrem suas testemunhas, para que se justifiquem, e se ouça, e se diga: É verdade.
verses.en_web: Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the peoples be assembled. Who among them can declare this, and show us former things? Let them bring their witnesses, that they may be justified; or let them hear, and say, “That is true.”
verses.en_bbe: Let all the nations come together, and let the peoples be present: who among them is able to make this clear, and give us word of earlier things? let their witnesses come forward, so that they may be seen to be true, and that they may give ear, and say, It is true.

verses.en: Ye are my witnesses, saith the LORD, and my servant whom I have chosen: that ye may know and believe me, and understand that I am he: before me there was no God formed, neither shall there be after me.
verses.pt: Vós sois minhas testemunhas (diz o SENHOR); e meu servo, a quem escolhi; para que saibais, e creiais em mim, e entendais que eu sou o próprio, e que antes de mim nenhum Deus se formou, e depois de minha nenhum haverá.
verses.en_web: “You are my witnesses,” says Yahweh, “With my servant whom I have chosen; that you may know and believe me, and understand that I am he. Before me there was no God formed, neither will there be after me.
verses.en_bbe: You are my witnesses, says the Lord, and my servant whom I have taken for myself: so that you may see and have faith in me, and that it may be clear to you that I am he; before me there was no God formed, and there will not be after me.

verses.en: I, even I, am the LORD; and beside me there is no saviour.
verses.pt: Eu, eu sou o SENHOR; e fora de mim não há salvador.
verses.en_web: I myself am Yahweh; and besides me there is no savior.
verses.en_bbe: I, even I, am the Lord; and there is no saviour but me.

verses.en: I have declared, and have saved, and I have shewed, when there was no strange god among you: therefore ye are my witnesses, saith the LORD, that I am God.
verses.pt: Eu anunciei, eu salvei, e eu fiz ouvir, e deus estrangeiro não houve entre vós, e vós sois minhas testemunhas, (diz o SENHOR), que eu sou Deus.
verses.en_web: I have declared, I have saved, and I have shown; and there was no strange god among you. Therefore you are my witnesses”, says Yahweh, “and I am God.
verses.en_bbe: I gave the word, and made it clear, and there was no strange god among you: for this reason you are my witnesses, says the Lord.

verses.en: Yea, before the day was I am he; and there is none that can deliver out of my hand: I will work, and who shall let it?
verses.pt: E desde antes de haver dia, eu o sou; e ninguém há que possa livrar das minhas mãos. Eu estou agindo, quem pode impedir?
verses.en_web: Yes, since the day was, I am he; and there is no one who can deliver out of my hand. I will work, and who can hinder it?”
verses.en_bbe: From time long past I am God, and from this day I am he: there is no one who is able to take you out of my hand: when I undertake a thing, by whom will my purpose be changed?

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD, your redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; For your sake I have sent to Babylon, and have brought down all their nobles, and the Chaldeans, whose cry is in the ships.
verses.pt: Assim diz o SENHOR o teu Redentor, o Santo de Israel: Por causa de vós eu enviei inimigos a Babilônia, e a todos eu os fiz descerem como fugitivos, inclusive os Caldeus, nos navios em que se orgulhavam.
verses.en_web: Yahweh, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel says: “For your sake, I have sent to Babylon, and I will bring all of them down as fugitives, even the Chaldeans, in the ships of their rejoicing.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord, who has taken up your cause, the Holy One of Israel, says, Because of you I have sent to Babylon, and made all their seers come south, and the Chaldaeans whose cry is in the ships.

verses.en: I am the LORD, your Holy One, the creator of Israel, your King.
verses.pt: Eu sou o SENHOR, vosso Santo; o Criador de Israel, o vosso Rei.
verses.en_web: I am Yahweh, your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, your King.”
verses.en_bbe: I am the Lord, your Holy One, the Maker of Israel, your King.

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD, which maketh a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters;
verses.pt: Assim diz o SENHOR, aquele que preparou no mar um caminho, e nas águas impetuosas uma vereda;
verses.en_web: Yahweh, who makes a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters says:
verses.en_bbe: This is the word of the Lord, who makes a way in the sea, and a road through the deep waters;

verses.en: Which bringeth forth the chariot and horse, the army and the power; they shall lie down together, they shall not rise: they are extinct, they are quenched as tow.
verses.pt: Aquele que trouxe carruagens e cavalos, exército e forças; todos juntamente caíram, e não mais se levantaram; estão extintos, foram apagados como um pavio:
verses.en_web: who brings out the chariot and horse, the army and the mighty man (they lie down together, they shall not rise; they are extinct, they are quenched like a wick):
verses.en_bbe: Who sends out the war-carriages and the horses, the army with all its force; they have come down, they will not get up again; like a feebly burning light they are put out.

verses.en: Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old.
verses.pt: Não vos lembreis das coisas passadas, nem considereis as antigas;
verses.en_web: “Don’t remember the former things, and don’t consider the things of old.
verses.en_bbe: Give no thought to the things which are past; let the early times go out of your minds.

verses.en: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
verses.pt: Eis que farei uma coisa nova, agora surgirá; por acaso não a reconhecereis? Pois porei um caminho no deserto, e rios na terra vazia.
verses.en_web: Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs out now. Don’t you know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
verses.en_bbe: See, I am doing a new thing; now it is starting; will you not take note of it? I will even make a way in the waste land, and rivers in the dry country.

verses.en: The beast of the field shall honour me, the dragons and the owls: because I give waters in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen.
verses.pt: Os animais do campo me honrarão; os chacais e os filhotes de avestruz; porque porei águas no deserto, rios na terra vazia, para dar de beber a meu povo, meu escolhido.
verses.en_web: The animals of the field shall honor me, the jackals and the ostriches; because I give water in the wilderness and rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen,
verses.en_bbe: The beasts of the field will give me honour, the jackals and the ostriches: because I send out waters in the waste land, and rivers in the dry country, to give drink to the people whom I have taken for myself:

verses.en: This people have I formed for myself; they shall shew forth my praise.
verses.pt: Este povo formei para mim, eles declararão louvor a mim.
verses.en_web: the people which I formed for myself, that they might declare my praise.
verses.en_bbe: Even the people whom I made to be the witnesses of my praise.

verses.en: But thou hast not called upon me, O Jacob; but thou hast been weary of me, O Israel.
verses.pt: Porém tu não me invocaste, ó Jacó; pois te cansaste de mim, ó Israel.
verses.en_web: Yet you have not called on me, Jacob; but you have been weary of me, Israel.
verses.en_bbe: But you have made no prayer to me, O Jacob: and you have given no thought to me, O Israel.

verses.en: Thou hast not brought me the small cattle of thy burnt offerings; neither hast thou honoured me with thy sacrifices. I have not caused thee to serve with an offering, nor wearied thee with incense.
verses.pt: Não me trouxeste o gado miúdo de teus holocaustos, nem me honraste com teus sacrifícios; eu não vos oprimi com ofertas, nem te cansei com incenso.
verses.en_web: You have not brought me of your sheep for burnt offerings; neither have you honored me with your sacrifices. I have not burdened you with offerings, nor wearied you with frankincense.
verses.en_bbe: You have not made me burned offerings of sheep, or given me honour with your offerings of beasts; I did not make you servants to give me an offering, and I did not make you tired with requests for perfumes.

verses.en: Thou hast bought me no sweet cane with money, neither hast thou filled me with the fat of thy sacrifices: but thou hast made me to serve with thy sins, thou hast wearied me with thine iniquities.
verses.pt: Não me compraste com dinheiro cana aromática, nem me saciaste com a gordura de teus sacrifícios; mas me oprimiste com teus pecados, e me cansaste com tuas maldades.
verses.en_web: You have bought me no sweet cane with money, nor have you filled me with the fat of your sacrifices; but you have burdened me with your sins. You have wearied me with your iniquities.
verses.en_bbe: You have not got me sweet-smelling plants with your money, or given me pleasure with the fat of your offerings: but you have made me a servant to your sins, and you have made me tired with your evil doings.

verses.en: I, even I, am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake, and will not remember thy sins.
verses.pt: Eu, eu sou o que anulo tuas transgressões por causa de mim; e te teus pecados eu não me lembro.
verses.en_web: I, even I, am he who blots out your transgressions for my own sake; and I will not remember your sins.
verses.en_bbe: I, even I, am he who takes away your sins; and I will no longer keep your evil doings in mind.

verses.en: Put me in remembrance: let us plead together: declare thou, that thou mayest be justified.
verses.pt: Faze-me lembrar, entremos em juízo juntos; mostra teus argumentos,para que possas te justificar.
verses.en_web: Put me in remembrance. Let us plead together. Declare your case, that you may be justified.
verses.en_bbe: Put me in mind of this; let us take up the cause between us: put forward your cause, so that you may be seen to be in the right.

verses.en: Thy first father hath sinned, and thy teachers have transgressed against me.
verses.pt: Teu primeiro pai pecou; e teus intérpretes transgrediram contra mim.
verses.en_web: Your first father sinned, and your teachers have transgressed against me.
verses.en_bbe: Your first father was a sinner, and your guides have gone against my word.

verses.en: Therefore I have profaned the princes of the sanctuary, and have given Jacob to the curse, and Israel to reproaches.
verses.pt: Por isso profanei os líderes do santuário, e entreguei Jacó à desgraça, e Israel à humilhação.
verses.en_web: Therefore I will profane the princes of the sanctuary; and I will make Jacob a curse, and Israel an insult.”
verses.en_bbe: Your chiefs have made my holy place unclean, so I have made Jacob a curse, and Israel a thing of shame.
